Definition: from G3962; paternal, i.e. ancestral:--of fathers.
BiblicalUsage: Patrikos means of the fathers, paternal, ancestral. It appears once, in Galatians 1:14, where Paul says he profited in the Jews' religion above many of his equals, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Paul's zeal for his fathers' traditions is what made his conversion so costly, and the traditions he once defended are the ones the gospel set him free from.
